Artform.Scores.Statement.balancedRule : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : Type) [inst : CommRing S] (u v : Sˣ),
  ↑(Artform.Scores.balanced u) = !![↑u, 0; 0, ↑u⁻¹] ∧
    Artform.Scores.balanced u * Artform.Scores.balanced v = Artform.Scores.balanced (u * v) ∧
      Artform.Scores.realize (Artform.Scores.balancedScore u) = Artform.Scores.balanced u

Artform.Scores.Statement.readingComplete : Prop :=
  Artform.Scores.Statement.readingDetermines ∧
  (∀ (S : Type) [inst : CommRing S] (A B : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) S),
      Artform.Scores.phase A = Artform.Scores.phase B ∧ Artform.Scores.reading A = Artform.Scores.reading B ↔
        ∀ (n : ℕ), ↑(A ^ n) 0 0 = ↑(B ^ n) 0 0) ∧
    (∀ (A : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℝ) (θ : ℝ),
        Artform.Scores.phase A = 2 * Real.cos θ →
          Real.sin θ ≠ 0 →
            ∀ (n : ℕ), ↑(A ^ n) 0 0 = Real.cos (↑n * θ) + (↑A 0 0 - ↑A 1 1) / 2 * Real.sin (↑n * θ) / Real.sin θ) ∧
      ∀ (S : Type) [inst : CommRing S] (A : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) S) (ε : S),
        ε * ε = 1 →
          Artform.Scores.phase A = 2 * ε →
            ∀ (n : ℕ), ↑(A ^ n) 0 0 = ε ^ n * (1 + ↑n * (ε * Artform.Scores.reading A - 1))

Artform.Scores.Statement.callerCutComplete : Prop :=
  Artform.Scores.Statement.callerCut ∧
  ∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] (h gx gy q : K),
    Artform.Scores.cut
          (q • ↑(Artform.Scores.splitTick true h gx gy) + (1 - q) • ↑(Artform.Scores.splitTick false h gx gy)) =
        0 ↔
      q = 1 / 2 ∨ h = 0 ∨ gx = gy

Artform.Scores.Statement.oneBackStep : Prop :=
  ∀ (G : Type) [inst : Group G] [Finite G] (A B : G) (σ : Equiv.Perm G) (x₀ : G),
  (∀ (x : G), x ≠ x₀ → σ x = A * x ∨ σ x = B * x) →
    (σ x₀ = A⁻¹ * x₀ → A * B ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (A⁻¹ * B)) ∧ (σ x₀ = B⁻¹ * x₀ → B * A ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (A⁻¹ * B))

Artform.Scores.Statement.platonicIncidence : Prop :=
  Artform.Scores.Statement.platonicSolids ∧
  (Artform.Scores.PrimitiveGraphModel 3 4 fun i j => i ≠ j) ∧
    Artform.Scores.PrimitiveGraphModel 4 6 Artform.Scores.octahedronAdj ∧
      Artform.Scores.PrimitiveGraphModel 5 12 Artform.Scores.icosahedronAdj

Artform.Scores.Statement.steinbergRules : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : Type) [inst : CommRing S] (c : ℕ) (i j k l : Fin c) (f g : S),
  (i ≠ j →
      Artform.Scores.realizeC [{ i := i, j := j, f := f }, { i := i, j := j, f := g }] =
        Artform.Scores.realizeC [{ i := i, j := j, f := f + g }]) ∧
    Artform.Scores.realizeC [{ i := i, j := j, f := 0 }] = 1 ∧
      (j ≠ k →
          i ≠ l →
            Artform.Scores.realizeC [{ i := i, j := j, f := f }, { i := k, j := l, f := g }] =
              Artform.Scores.realizeC [{ i := k, j := l, f := g }, { i := i, j := j, f := f }]) ∧
        (i ≠ j →
          j ≠ k →
            i ≠ k →
              Matrix.transvection i j f * Matrix.transvection j k g * Matrix.transvection i j (-f) *
                    Matrix.transvection j k (-g) =
                  Matrix.transvection i k (f * g) ∧
                Artform.Scores.realizeC
                      [{ i := j, j := k, f := -g }, { i := i, j := j, f := -f }, { i := j, j := k, f := g },
                        { i := i, j := j, f := f }] =
                    { i := i, j := k, f := f * g }.mat ∧
                  Artform.Scores.realizeC
                      [{ i := i, j := j, f := f }, { i := j, j := k, f := g }, { i := i, j := j, f := -f },
                        { i := j, j := k, f := -g }] =
                    { i := i, j := k, f := -(f * g) }.mat)

Artform.Scores.Statement.indexGroupComplete : Prop :=
  Artform.Scores.Statement.indexGroup ∧
  ∀ (n : ℕ),
    n ≠ 0 →
      Artform.Scores.elementary (LaurentPolynomial (ZMod n)) = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det.ker ∧
        Function.Surjective ⇑Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det

Artform.Scores.Statement.faceAndLinkNormalization : Prop :=
  Artform.Scores.Statement.faceAndLink ∧
  ∀ (F : Type) [inst : Field F] (κ ℓ : F) (w : Artform.Scores.Score F),
    Artform.Scores.totalKick w * κ ≠ 0 →
      have Tf := Artform.Scores.realize (List.map (Artform.Scores.faceStep κ ℓ) w);
      have Tl := Artform.Scores.realize (List.map (Artform.Scores.linkStep κ ℓ) w);
      ∀ (B : Type) [inst_1 : CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsIntegrallyClosed B] (ι : LaurentPolynomial F →+* B),
        Function.Injective ⇑ι →
          ∀ (lam : B),
            lam * lam - ι (Artform.Scores.phase Tf) * lam + 1 = 0 →
              Ideal.span {ι (↑Tl 1 0), lam - ι (↑Tl 0 0)} =
                Ideal.span {ι (Artform.Scores.diffDs F)} * Ideal.span {ι (↑Tf 1 0), lam - ι (↑Tf 0 0)}

Artform.Scores.Statement.leapfrogNormalization : Prop :=
  Artform.Scores.Statement.leapfrogCurve ∧
  ∀ (F : Type) [inst : Field F] (q : F),
    2 ≠ 0 →
      q ≠ 0 →
        q ≠ 1 →
          IsIntegrallyClosed (Artform.Scores.Leapfrog.Norm q) ∧
            (∃ ι,
                Function.Injective ⇑ι ∧
                  (∀ (z : Artform.Scores.Leapfrog.Norm q), ∃ p, p.Monic ∧ Polynomial.eval₂ ι z p = 0) ∧
                    (∀ (z : Artform.Scores.Leapfrog.Norm q), ∃ a d, d ≠ 0 ∧ ι d * z = ι a) ∧
                      ι (Artform.Scores.eig (Artform.Scores.Leapfrog.phaseT q)) =
                        1 +
                          (ι
                                ((algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial F)
                                    (Artform.Scores.curveRing (Artform.Scores.Leapfrog.phaseT q)))
                                  (LaurentPolynomial.T 1)) -
                              1) *
                            Artform.Scores.Leapfrog.sN q) ∧
              (∀ (x lam : F),
                  x ≠ 0 →
                    lam ≠ 0 →
                      (x * (lam - 1) ^ 2 - q * (x - 1) ^ 2 * lam = 0 ∧
                          (lam - 1) ^ 2 - 2 * q * (x - 1) * lam = 0 ∧ 2 * x * (lam - 1) - q * (x - 1) ^ 2 = 0 ↔
                        x = 1 ∧ lam = 1)) ∧
                (∀ (u v : F),
                    (1 + u) * (1 + v - 1) ^ 2 - q * (1 + u - 1) ^ 2 * (1 + v) =
                      v ^ 2 - q * u ^ 2 + u * v ^ 2 - q * u ^ 2 * v) ∧
                  (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C q).Separable ∧
                    ∀ (h : F), h * h = q → h ≠ -h ∧ ∀ (u v : F), v ^ 2 - q * u ^ 2 = (v - h * u) * (v + h * u)
